description: This Java source file defines a custom Hibernate ID generator class 'NativeIfNotAssignedIdentityGenerator'. It extends Hibernate's IdentityGenerator to allow overriding auto-generated IDs with explicitly assigned IDs during entity persistence, based on runtime conditions. The class implements the Configurable interface to set up the entity name and checks if an ID has been assigned before generating a new one.

classes.name: NativeIfNotAssignedIdentityGenerator
classes.description: A custom Hibernate identity generator that allows explicitly assigned primary keys to override automatic generation when saving entities. It checks if an ID has already been assigned; if not, it delegates to the default generation method.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Overridden method to generate an entity ID. Returns an existing assigned ID if present; otherwise, generates a new one.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configured method to set the entity name from parameters, used during Hibernate initialization.
